verdict.rationale: Postmark documents ways to protect webhooks: HTTP Basic Authentication on the webhook URL, IP allowlisting of Postmark's senders, payload shape validation and an idempotency pattern, with Node/TypeScript code for each. Nothing in the pack shows cryptographically signed payloads (e.g. an HMAC signature header) or signature-verification code, so authenticity relies on shared credentials and source IPs rather than per-payload signatures. Missing for 10: signed webhook payloads, documented signature verification code, independent corroboration of the webhook protection approach.
